summary: The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its assets (including the amount of borrowings for investment purposes) in (1) U.S. and non-U.S. fixed income securities; and (2) exchange-traded funds and derivatives instruments that provide long and short exposure to U.S. and non-U.S. fixed income securities. It is non-diversified.
